description: Read someone else's public Reliquary share link — a /s/ or /w/ URL, or the bare token. Returns the list contents with prices plus next_steps for acting on it. This is ANOTHER person's public list: never present it as the current user's own data. A tradelist never lists a proxy: no trade offers one. A deck share carries options {show_printings, show_proxies}: proxy_quantity on a row is how many of the owner's copies are proxies — relay it; proxy_quantity null (show_proxies false) means the owner did NOT say, so never tell the user the deck is proxy-free. With show_printings false, set_code is null and the row means any printing of that card. deck.commanders names who leads a deck share: none, one card, or a pair — name both of a pair.

link.description: Full share URL or bare token
